title: Cartwise+ Membership Carried-Value Handling Amounts by Late-Payment Record
content:
The handling amount taken off a Cartwise+ Membership carried-value refund follows the membership's record of late payments over the last twelve months.

**Schedule.** A membership with no retry capture in the last twelve months pays a handling amount of 0.00. A membership with exactly one retry capture in that time pays 0.25. For any other membership this schedule sets no amount.

| Retry captures on the membership in the last twelve months | Handling amount (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.00 |
| 1 | 0.25 |
| 2 or more | not set under this schedule |

## Definitions

- **Retry capture.** A fee charge of the renewal-retry type on the membership: a declined period fee that was captured on a later attempt, whether by an automatic retry or by the member settling a past-due fee in person.
- **Last twelve months.** Counted in whole months ending today; a capture dated on the same day of the month twelve months back is not counted.

## Hypothetical cases

| Today | Retry captures dated | Counted | Handling amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 18 August | none | 0 | 0.00 |
| 18 August | 2 March of this year | 1 | 0.25 |
| 18 August | 18 August of the previous year | 0 (exactly twelve months back) | 0.00 |
| 18 August | 2 March and 2 May of this year | 2 | not set under this schedule |
